## Native final prefix

## Verdict

**I developed a concrete process and an executable model, but I cannot honestly claim an invention that meets your complete target.** The process below can conditionally produce the required quantity and core product quality in its 100-hour model. Its industrial case fails both the energy and cost requirements.

The candidate is **alkaline iron electrowinning with ore-depletion cassettes, washing before cathode peeling, and a separately metered impurity-removal circuit**. Its intended advantage is to preserve iron recovery while removing gangue and returning caustic. The unresolved physical issue is whether those operations can sustain useful electrochemical performance on the selected ore.

Conditional physical designs and arithmetic; no apparatus, supplier quote, lifetime qualification or full-system advantage is established.

1. Actual distinct source exposure
Maihatchi et al., J. Electrochem. Sci. Eng.10(2)(2020)95--102, DOI10.5599/jese.751, exact https://hrcak.srce.hr/file/342165 : main Experimental, Results and Discussion/Conclusion through p102 read. The 0.8L stirred, externally thermostated, nitrogen-swept cell used a19.4cm2 graphite cathode/Ti-Pt grid,110C/12.5MNaOH. Actual tested red mud performed very differently from commercial hematite. Particle-surface inhibition is a proposed explanation; the suggested cancrinite/sodalite coating was not directly evidenced. Dissolved-impurity cleaning cannot be assumed to restore ore contact. No cited original, SI or linked artifact was followed.

Landman et al., Nature Materials2017, DOI10.1038/nmat4876, author arXiv2012.04441v1, exact https://arxiv.org/pdf/2012.04441v1 : main results and Methods through pp16--17 read. Commercial Ni-hydroxide auxiliary electrodes mediated two separate ambient1MNaOH cells; initial activation, switching and charge drift matter. The125h case reported2.12V mean/0.12V auxiliary-pair loss. Higher-current Methods used Ir/Ti and Pt/Ti and unequal electrode areas. Gas results do not supply a5ppm detection limit,30bar operation, complete cost or lifetime. The mechanism is credited prior art, not a new invention. No cited original/SI was followed.

The complete AVAILABLE ore design has an accounted feed and conditional harvesting/washing/guard process. Its5.592MWh/t energy and684USD/t at40USD/MWh are engineering-model premises, not measurements. Of that energy4.709MWh/t is cell/rectifier and0.883 is other declared supply energy.

An INTRODUCED jointly-unmeasured1.7V/.90FE point gives2.86272MWh/t cell and3.74572 total with the old other loads. Even simultaneously waiving ALL32.2lime+28.5caustic+3.9acid+45.8waste/waterUSD/t and crediting that electrical saving leaves499.75USD/t.
